judgments.reason: Transcript shows normal payment then commission for auction winners; no event where a bid above available coins won due to commission being applied before payment, and the model did not articulate that mechanism.

The play shows committed bids are revealed only when lots resolve; the focal player never used waiting to observe rivals' sealed bids before committing its own. The model text does not articulate the claimed information-timing mechanism.
Settlement occurred after all lots were sold (normal behavior). There is no observed early settlement with unsold lots, and the model did not claim or explain such an early-settlement discrepancy.
No catalog purchase receiving an auction commission occurs in the transcript, and the model did not articulate a mechanism where purchases get the auction commission instead of auction winners.
